title: Practice: Reaching and crossing: до- and пере-

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson before this one teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: He's a little slow on the uptake.
exercises.why: «до-»: доходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Не ___ (переходить) в крайности. Умеренность важна во всём.
exercises.prompt: Don't go to extremes. To be moderate is important in anything.
exercises.why: «пере-»: переходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Кто ___ (перевести) это стихотворение на таджикский язык?
exercises.prompt: Who translated this poem into the Tajik language?
exercises.why: «пере-»: перевести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«до-»: доводить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«до-»: довезти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The ship transports raw materials from Indonesia.
exercises.why: «пере-»: перевозить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«пере-»: переносить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: It hasn't come to that yet.
exercises.why: «до-»: дойти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«пере-»: перейти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«до-»: доехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The butterfly fluttered from flower to flower.
exercises.why: «пере-»: перелетать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«пере-»: переводить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: His classmates' jeers reduced him to tears.
exercises.why: «до-»: довести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том ___ (переехать) в Финляндию и стал оленеводом.
exercises.prompt: Tom moved to Finland and became a reindeer herder.
exercises.why: «пере-»: переехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
